name: sema
description: Codex bootstrap for discovering @semacode/cli and initializing Sema before a workspace has its AGENTS.md protocol.

interface.longDescription: Provides the required first-contact instructions for Codex to find the local @semacode/cli, initialize Sema, and generate AGENTS.md. Once AGENTS.md exists, the skill delegates all workspace governance to that protocol and the local CLI.
defaultPrompt: Initialize Sema in this project and prepare its AGENTS.md protocol for Codex
Install or locate the Sema CLI and bootstrap this workspace
Repair a missing Sema AGENTS.md handshake in this project
